commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.

90+4' What a great touch by Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee blows his whistle, Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Eintracht Frankfurt keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Some patient build-up play from Eintracht Frankfurt as they look to unlock the defence.
86' Substitution. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) in, Mario Gotze out.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Finn Ole Becker cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Florian Grillitsch is replaced by Kasim Adams (Hoffenheim).
85' A substitution has been made. Ellyes Skhiri goes off and Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.

84' Eintracht Frankfurt hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
81' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

78' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Bastian Dankert shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
77' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
74' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a yellow card.
72' Here is a change. Anton Stach is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim).
72' Substitution. Andrej Kramaric walks off the pitch and Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
72' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Hugo Larsson.
72' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Junior Dina Ebimbe.
70' Some neat passing and movement from Hoffenheim as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
67' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
64' 3 - 1 Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass inside the box from Ansgar Knauff and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 3:1.
63' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Kevin Trapp is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
62' Eintracht Frankfurt hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
60' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

58' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
57' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card!

56' Close! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
55' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) replaces Stanley Nsoki.

54' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt). This could have been a legendary goal. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
50' 2 - 1 Goal! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes the score 2:1 after burying a close-range header in the top left corner after a good run and cross by Mario Gotze.
46' The whistle blows and Bastian Dankert starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

45+2' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
45+1' Eintracht Frankfurt keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' The manager makes a subsitution with Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) coming on for Fares Chaibi.
40' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
36' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
32' 1 - 1 Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
31' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
30' A spell of possession for Eintracht Frankfurt in an attempt to control the game.
28' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
27' The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
24' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
22' It's a red card! John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) can't believe his eyes as he is being sent off by the referee.

20' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Oliver Baumann thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
20' Some great controlled play and passing from Eintracht Frankfurt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

17' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Bastian Dankert with no other option than to blow for a foul.

16' What a huge chance for Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
14' Hoffenheim are seeing far more of the ball now.
12' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
9' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Bastian Dankert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
8' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
6' 0 - 1 It's a goal! John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) puts the ball past the goalkeeper!
6' Good work from Hoffenheim as they win a corner.
5' Hoffenheim string together a series of short passes.

3' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Oliver Baumann.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
